name: file_find
description: Find files/dirs under a path by name glob, extension, type, size, mtime window or emptiness (the read-only find)

path.description: directory (or single file) to search (default: project root)

name.description: glob on the base name ('*.log'); a plain word means contains

newer_min.description: modified within the last N minutes

older_min.description: modified more than N minutes ago

empty.description: only empty files or empty directories

include_hidden.description: also scan dot-files and dot-dirs (default false)
